narrative.details:
It... It... It was all a trap.

Forgive... me.

Kill the bastard... Kill him for us... for Thorius.
narrative.objectives: Slay Lathoric the Black and Obsidion, and return to Thorius in Ironforge with the Head of Lathoric the Black and the Heart of Obsidion.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Thorius' face turns white.>This... this cannot be. My own brother? He set this all up?<Thorius' face contorts in anger.>He betrayed me, he betrayed Ironforge! It seems as if the influence of the Old Gods is still strong in these lands. I fear that if my brother - a once noble and honorable man - was so easily turned to the will of Ragnaros, no one is safe.
narrative.requestItemsText: I don't believe you! Show me proof!
